metadata.question: On July 19, 2022 did UK experience temperatures above 100 degrees fahrenheit?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY for temperature data (high resolution) - Date: July 19, 2022 (single day) - Location: UK geometry (will define a polygon covering UK) - Band: 'temperature_2m' which is in Kelvin 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for ERA5 (modeled data, not optical imagery) - Just need to extract temperature values 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Convert Kelvin to Fahrenheit: F = (K - 273.15) × 9/5 + 32 - 100°F = 37.78°C = 310.93K - Check if maximum temperature in UK exceeds 100°F (310.93K) - Valid range: typical summer temps 280-320K (reasonable check) - If max temp > 310.93K → Answer A (Yes) - If max temp <= 310.93K → Answer B (No) - If no data or invalid → C1/C2/C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define UK geometry (approximate bounding box) const uk = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-8.5, 49.5], [2.0, 49.5], [2.0, 61.0], [-8.5, 61.0], [-8.5, 49.5]] ]); // 2. Get ERA5 temperature data for July 19, 2022 const startDate = '2022-07-19'; const endDate = '2022-07-20'; const tempCollection = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(uk) .select('temperature_2m'); const collectionSize = tempCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No temperature data available for July 19, 2022.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Get maximum temperature across all hours of the day const maxTemp = tempCollection.max(); // 4. Calculate statistics over UK const stats = maxTemp.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: uk, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const maxTempK = stats['temperature_2m_max']; const pixelCount = stats['temperature_2m_count']; console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels found.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (maxTempK === null || maxTempK === undefined) { console.log('Temperature calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 5. Convert to Fahrenheit and check const maxTempC = maxTempK - 273.15; const maxTempF = maxTempC * 9/5 + 32; console.log(`Max temperature: ${maxTempK.toFixed(2)}K = ${maxTempC.toFixed(2)}°C = ${maxTempF.toFixed(2)}°F`); // Sanity check if (maxTempK < 250 || maxTempK > 330) { console.log('Temperature out of reasonable range.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 6. Final answer if (maxTempF > 100) { console.log('UK experienced temperatures above 100°F on July 19, 2022.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('UK did NOT experience temperatures above 100°F on July 19, 2022.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
